meta.title: Product roadmap | Puntr
meta.description: What's live on Puntr and what's coming next: football at launch, then basketball, rugby, horse racing, combat sports, cricket and tennis.

title: Football first. More sports every few weeks.
intro: Puntr launches with football (soccer) on {{launch}}. Here's the order the other sports join, with target weeks counted from launch. This page updates itself: a sport only shows as live once its fixtures are on Puntr.

soccer.name: Football (soccer)
soccer.body: Betway Premiership, Premier League, Champions League and more leagues as they are added. Post picks, get graded, climb the weekly leaderboard.

basketball.name: Basketball
basketball.body: Picks on the same locked, public record. We'll confirm the leagues closer to the time.

rugby.name: Rugby
rugby.body: United Rugby Championship and Springbok tests.

racing.name: Horse racing
racing.body: Race cards and picks. Racing needs its own way of recording picks, so it follows a little later.

cricket.name: Cricket
cricket.body: Competitions confirmed closer to the time.

tennis.name: Tennis
tennis.body: Tournaments confirmed closer to the time.

alsoIntro: No dates yet. We'll add them here once they're set.

languages.title: Afrikaans, isiZulu and isiXhosa
languages.body: Each language goes live once a native speaker has reviewed it.

rewards.title: PuntPoints rewards
rewards.body: Points for taking part, redeemable for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. Never cash.

pro.title: Puntr Pro
pro.body: Extra tools for members who want more. Puntr stays free to join.

note: Target dates can move. We'd rather add a sport late than add it before its fixtures and grading are reliable.

suggest.title: Want a sport or league sooner?
suggest.body: Tell us what you'd use. Requests from members shape the order.
